user.title: Freebox Parental Control
user.description: Enter your Freebox local address. Home Assistant must be on the same network as the Freebox.

authorize.title: Approve on your Freebox
authorize.description: Look at the Freebox front panel (LCD screen) and press the right arrow, then OK to grant access. Then submit to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Freebox. Check the address and that Home Assistant is on the same LAN.
error.invalid_auth: The Freebox rejected the token. Try again.
error.awaiting_confirmation: Still waiting for you to confirm on the Freebox LCD screen. Press the arrow + OK, then submit again.
error.authorization_failed: Authorization was denied or timed out. Restart the setup and confirm on the box.

init.title: Internet cut schedules
init.description: Select a schedule to edit it, add a new one, or finish.

edit.title: Schedule: {name}
edit.description: Internet is cut at the cut time on the chosen days and restored at the restore time. Tick "Delete" to remove this schedule.
